## Summary
Optimization loop running well — 367 iterations over ~39 hours, ~8.5 hours remaining.

| Metric | Champion | Last PASS Candidate |
|--------|----------|---------------------|
| Tuning Mean | **1.904** | 1.762 |
| Tuning Min | **0.431** | 0.051 ⚠️ |
| Lockbox Mean | 1.793 | **1.793** |
| Lockbox Min | 1.134 | **1.347** |
| Worst MDD | **-9.3%** | -11.2% |

## Assessment

**Champion remains correctly selected.** The candidate shows:
- ✅ Better lockbox minimum (more consistent OOS)
- ⚠️ Dangerously low tuning minimum (0.05) — near-zero on one fold
- ⚠️ Worse drawdown (-11.2% vs -9.3%)

The low tuning minimum suggests potential instability despite reasonable lockbox performance.

## Recommended Actions

Loop is healthy — let it continue with the provided commands:

```bash
python3 experiment_system/tools/aub_autopilot.py --registry experiment_system/config/module_registry.yaml --run --select-best
python3 experiment_system/tools/system_autopilot.py --spec experiment_system/config/system_candidates.yaml --run
python3 experiment_system/tools/aub_next_fix.py --registry experiment_system/config/module_registry.yaml --output baseline/reports/next_fix.md
```

No intervention needed. System is progressing normally with reasonable champion protection.
